title: hub.fact.drop_off_accepted v1 payload
description: ADR-0011 H1 — the second way custody can begin. v6.3 p.18: a regular customer's parcel gets no pickup; hub staff label and scan it, and 'from this point, the parcel is treated exactly as an accepted parcel would be — custody begins'. Shipment consumes this exactly as it consumes pickup.fact.accepted. The receiver's contact details are not published: Hub does not hold them and does not need to.

drop_off_id.description: DropOff aggregate id; MUST equal envelope aggregate_id.

shipment_request_id.description: Present when the customer entered details in the app beforehand; null when hub staff took them on the spot (v6.3 p.18).

label_code.description: Applied and scanned by hub staff, never by the customer (CUS-05).

weight_grams.description: The hub weighs the parcel at drop-off (CUS-07).

accepting_actor_id.description: The hub operator who accepted custody. Every custody change is attributable (SEC-09).
